attchmntText: Manappuram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Manappuram Finance Limited Board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs. 1 per equity share of face value Rs. 2. The record date for the dividend is November 18, 2026. Shareholders whose names appear in the beneficial owner list or register of members as of the end of business hours on November 18, 2026, are eligible. The company submitted limited review reports from auditors Chokshi & Chokshi LLP and KKC & Associates LLP. Disclosures regarding utilization of proceeds from preferential issues, non-convertible securities, security cover, and commercial papers were also filed. The Board meeting commenced at 12:00 Noon and concluded at 4:30 P.M. on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Manappuram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Manappuram Finance Limited submitted its Q2 FY2027 investor presentation to stock exchanges on November 12, 2026. Consolidated assets under management reached 73,303 crore rupees, up 60.1 percent year on year. Consolidated profit after tax was 701 crore rupees, a 222.9 percent increase from the same period last year. Standalone profit after tax was 665 crore rupees. The company reported a return on assets of 3.89 percent and a return on equity of 16.51 percent. Gold assets under management stood at 60,640 crore rupees. The board of directors met on November 12, 2026, to review these financial results. The presentation details segmental performance and operational metrics for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Manappuram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Narayanan Easwaran as Group Chief Technology Officer of the company w.e.f. November 07, 2026.
voiceSummary: Manappuram Finance Limited has intimated the resignation of Mr. Narayanan Easwaran, Group Chief Technology Officer and Senior Management Personnel. The resignation is due to personal reasons. It becomes effective from the close of business hours on November 7, 2026. The company filed this notice under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. Enclosures include the resignation letter and required details. The information is also available on the company website.
